 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.33284 of 2015
Order:

entities.text: Mushini Bharathavva vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development for the respondents and perused the entire material on record.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that this Court on 09.10.2015, directed the respondents not to lay road from the land of the petitioner in Survey No.197/AA to an extent of Acs.3.00 gts., situated at Ankireddipally Village, Kondapak Mandal, Medak District without acquiring the land and paying compensation to the petitioner.
3. In spite of lapse of more than eight (08) years, the respondents neither filed counter-affidavit nor vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioner in the writ affidavit.
4. In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner's property without following due process of law.

If the respondents wants to acquire the land ::2::
of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: However, there shall be no order as to costs.
5. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
